description_zh: 调用ListAccessConfigurationProvisionings查询访问配置部署列表
name: ListAccessConfigurationProvisionings

parameters.help_en: The access configuration ID used as a filter condition for the query
parameters.help_zh: 访问配置ID，用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: access_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The target type used as a filter condition for the query.

Valid values:
RD-Account: The target is an account in a resource directory.

You must specify both TargetId and TargetType for them to take effect as filter conditions
parameters.help_zh:
任务目标类型，用于查询的过滤条件。

取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号。

`TargetId`与`TargetType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The target ID used as a filter condition for the query.

You must specify both TargetId and TargetType for them to take effect as filter conditions
parameters.help_zh:
任务目标ID，用于查询的过滤条件。

`TargetId`与`TargetType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The provisioning status used as a filter condition for the query. Valid values:

Provisioned: The provisioning succeeded.
ReprovisionRequired: Reprovisioning is required.
DeprovisionFailed: The provisioning failed
parameters.help_zh:
部署状态，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

Provisioned：部署成功。
ReprovisionRequired：需要重新部署。
DeprovisionFailed：部署失败
parameters.name: provisioning_status

parameters.help_en:
The token used to return the next page of query results. You do not need to specify NextToken when you call this operation for the first time.

When you call this operation for the first time, if the total number of returned entries exceeds the value of MaxResults, the returned results are truncated. Only the number of entries specified by MaxResults is returned, the IsTruncated parameter is set to true, and a NextToken is returned. You can use the returned NextToken to call this operation again to query the truncated entries while keeping other request parameters unchanged. You can repeat this process until IsTruncated is set to false, which indicates that all entries are returned
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。首次调用API不需要`NextToken`。

当您首次调用API时，如果返回数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，数据会被截断，只返回`MaxResults`条数据，同时，返回参数`IsTruncated`为`true`，返回一个`NextToken`。您可以使用上一次返回的`NextToken`继续调用API，其他请求参数保持不变，查询被截断的数据。您可以按此方法多次查询，直到`IsTruncated`为`false`，表示全部数据查询完毕
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 20.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~20。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the provisioning target
parameters.name: origin_target_id

AccessConfigurationProvisionings.description_en: The list of access configuration provisionings

items.description_en: The list of access configuration provisionings

AccessConfigurationName.description_en: The name of the access configuration

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the first provisioning succeeded. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the RFC 3339 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 首次部署成功的时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

OriginTargetId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the provisioning target

RAMPolicyNames.description_en: The Policy Name of the custom policy created in the account in a resource directory
RAMPolicyNames.description_zh: 在RD账号中创建的自定义策略名称

items.description_en:
The Policy Name of the custom policy created in the account in a resource directory.

This parameter is returned only when the access configuration has a built-in policy
items.description_zh:
在RD账号中创建的自定义策略名称。

只有访问配置存在内置策略，才显示该参数

RAMRoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM role created in the account in a resource directory
RAMRoleName.description_zh: 在RD账号中创建的RAM角色名称

SAMLProviderName.description_en: The name of the SAML IdP created in the account in a resource directory
SAMLProviderName.description_zh: 在RD账号中创建的SAML身份提供商名称

Status.description_en:
The provisioning status. Valid values:

Provisioned: The provisioning succeeded.
ReprovisionRequired: Reprovisioning is required.
DeprovisionFailed: The provisioning failed
Status.description_zh:
部署状态。取值：

Provisioned：部署成功。
ReprovisionRequired：需要重新部署。
DeprovisionFailed：部署失败

TargetId.description_en:
The target ID.

If the target type is RD-Account, this parameter indicates the UID of the account in a resource directory
TargetId.description_zh:
任务目标ID。

当任务目标类型为`RD-Account`时，该参数为RD账号UID

TargetPath.description_en: The path ID of the target in the resource directory
TargetPath.description_zh: 任务目标在资源目录中的路径ID

TargetPathName.description_en: The path name of the target in the resource directory
TargetPathName.description_zh: 任务目标在资源目录中的路径名称

TargetType.description_en:
The target type.

Valid values:
RD-Account: The target is an account in a resource directory
TargetType.description_zh:
任务目标类型。

取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the latest provisioning succeeded. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the RFC 3339 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
UpdateTime.description_zh: 最近一次部署成功的时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the returned results are truncated. Valid values:

true: The results are truncated.
false: The results are not truncated
IsTruncated.description_zh:
返回结果是否被截断。取值：

true：已截断。
false：未截断

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned on each page

NextToken.description_en:
The token used to return the next page of query results.

This parameter is returned only when IsTruncated is set to true
NextToken.description_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。

只有`IsTruncated`为`true`，才显示该参数

TotalCounts.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the filter conditions specified in the request parameters
TotalCounts.description_zh: 符合请求参数条件的数据总条数
